title: Generic Programming and Reusable Algorithms
learningObjectives: Explain generic programming and reusable algorithms.
Identify template parameters and required operations.
Design a reusable generic utility or type.

understand.concept: Generic programming writes algorithms in terms of required operations, often using iterators. Standard algorithms can work with different containers if their iterator requirements are met.
understand.whyItMatters: Reusable algorithms avoid tying code to one specific container.
understand.explain: Algorithms use iterator ranges, generally half-open [begin,end). Requirements include iterator operations and expressions used by the algorithm.

practise.guidedTask: Analyze each Generic Programming and Reusable Algorithms example: identify parameters, requirements, deduced or explicit arguments, and instantiated behavior.
practise.independentTask: Write a generic C++ utility or type demonstrating generic programming and reusable algorithms. Test two supported types, one boundary case, and one unsupported/constrained type; explain why it is or is not accepted.
